title: Record XML key agreement in both library fixtures and re-pin every live map
body:
## Goal
Record the confirmed independent XML key agreement for A0001-A0010 in `oracle.independent_checker` of `benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json` (key `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0203.json`, cold session #872, check #873: 10/10) and `benchmark/cases/dev/library-icon-tests.json` (key `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0204-icon-tests.json`, cold session #877, check #878: 10/10 in both modes). Then re-pin every live pin map entry these edits change and update the `Next` line of `benchmark/challenges/README.md` (around line 28).
Changed files: the two fixtures, `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`, `benchmark/preparation.json`, `benchmark/challenges/README.md`. Nothing else.
Expected gain: both XML library fixtures carry a recorded independent check for A0001-A0010; all pins match disk. The next shaper reads the verification line and the report.
No session can run LabVIEW: this records XML text agreement only. N0001/N0002 stay native-unverified; do not change any `expected` value, `reference_status`, claim, denominator or other field.

## Acceptance
- [ ] In each fixture, `oracle.independent_checker` becomes: `status` `xml-agreed-A0001-A0010-native-pending`; `claim_agreements` a list of exactly ten objects, one per A0001..A0010, each `{"claim_id", "key_file", "key_sha256"}` (key_sha256 = sha256 of the key file bytes on disk); `identity` `{"key_file", "key_sha256", "checker": "benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py", "checker_sha256"}`; `session` `{"cold_key": <issue>, "check": <issue>}` (specialty 872/873, icon-tests 877/878). Edit only this object, with targeted Edit, keeping the file's existing formatting.
- [ ] Every entry naming a changed file in `protected_inputs_sha256` of `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` and in every `path`/`sha256` entry of `benchmark/preparation.json` (the fixtures appear twice there) is recomputed from disk; if one map pins the other, update that pin too.
- [ ] `python3 -B -I benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py --inventory <fixture> <key>` still prints `xml keys: 10/10 OK` for both pairs; quote both outputs.
- [ ] README `Next` line says both library inventories are confirmed 10/10 and names the next open gap from working state: native N-claims and the #831 citation-check limit remain.
- [ ] `git status --porcelain` shows only the five changed files (no `__pycache__`).

## Verification
`python3 -B -I -c "import json,hashlib,os; h=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest(); m=json.load(open('benchmark/writing/input-pins.json'))['protected_inputs_sha256']; bad=[p for p,s in m.items() if h(p)!=s]; P=[]; w=lambda o: [w(v) for v in (o.values() if isinstance(o,dict) else o if isinstance(o,list) else [])] + ([P.append((o['path'],o['sha256']))] if isinstance(o,dict) and isinstance(o.get('path'),str) and isinstance(o.get('sha256'),str) else []); w(json.load(open('benchmark/preparation.json'))); bad+=[p for p,s in P if os.path.exists(p) and h(p)!=s]; F=['benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json','benchmark/cases/dev/library-icon-tests.json']; assert all(f in m and f in dict(P) for f in F), 'fixture not pinned'; assert not bad, bad; ic=[json.load(open(f))['oracle']['independent_checker'] for f in F]; assert all(sorted(x['claim_id'] for x in i['claim_agreements'])==['A00%02d' % k for k in range(1,11)] for i in ic), ic; print('pins and checker records: OK')"`

## Context
- Current object in both fixtures: `"independent_checker": {"claim_agreements": [], "identity": null, "session": null, "status": "pending"}` (library-specialty.json line 137).
- Pin lessons: #857 f4 and #861 f1 failed review because one changed file was re-pinned and another live map was not. Recompute the whole maps, not one hash.
- Always `python3 -B -I` (#785). Do not run `git commit`; the parent commits.
- Role tools: a message "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session" is the CLI refusing a native tool; propose the same operation as a broker JSON action. It is not a block.

## Budget
- Read: the two fixtures (Grep `independent_checker`, then Read that range only), the two key files, `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`, `benchmark/preparation.json` (Grep `sha256`/`path`, ranges only), README.md lines 1-40. Do not read score.py, results, history, journal.
- Short command output; report within 35 turns.

title: Review the XML agreement records and re-pins of 0205
body:
## Goal
Independently review the merged change of task xml-agree-record-0205 to `benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json`, `benchmark/cases/dev/library-icon-tests.json`, `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`, `benchmark/preparation.json` and `benchmark/challenges/README.md`. Report, do not fix. Verdict CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR with numbered findings.
Expected gain: a CLEAR closes the XML key-agreement scope for both library inventories; the next shaper reads the verdict line of your report.
No session can run LabVIEW; judge XML text and recorded identity only.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Report pins the merged commit (`git log -1`) and sha256 of each of the five files.
- [ ] Diff against the parent commit (`git diff HEAD~1 -- <files>` or the merge commit) shows only `oracle.independent_checker` changed in each fixture; any other fixture change is a finding.
- [ ] Each `key_sha256` and `checker_sha256` matches the file on disk; each session pair is specialty 872/873, icon-tests 877/878.
- [ ] Every entry of `protected_inputs_sha256` and every `path`/`sha256` entry in `benchmark/preparation.json` is recomputed against disk; any mismatch is a finding.
- [ ] `python3 -B -I benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py --inventory` passes for both fixture/key pairs; quote output.
- [ ] Findings in `.session/report.md`, details in `.session/artifacts/`; no repository file written; `git status --porcelain` empty.

## Verification
`python3 -B -I benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py --inventory benchmark/cases/dev/library-icon-tests.json benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0204-icon-tests.json`

## Context
- Keys: `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0203.json` (specialty), `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0204-icon-tests.json` (icon-tests). Checker: `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py`.
- Prior pin failures: #857 f4, #861 f1 (stale second map).
- Always `python3 -B -I`. Do not run `git commit`.
- Role tools: a message "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session" is the CLI refusing a native tool; propose the same operation as a broker JSON action. It is not a block.

## Budget
- Read: the five changed files (fixtures by range around `independent_checker`), the two keys, the checker usage only. No score.py, results, history, journal.
- Short output; report within 30 turns.
